held.title: A refreshing compact Kpi tile now only anchors the shimmer if the sheen is a direct child of the tile.
held.body:
Before this change, a refreshing compact tile got `position: relative` from `.openui-dashboard-kpi-compact:has(.openui-dashboard-state[data-state="refreshing"])`, which matched at any depth. That wrapper div is gone. StateFrame now renders `<Sheen/>` and the loader as siblings of the content, and the only remaining rule for tiles is `.openui-dashboard-kpi-compact:has(> .openui-dashboard-sheen)`, which needs the sheen to be a direct child.

If the compact Kpi wraps `<StateFrame compact>` in any inner element, nothing anchors the sheen to the tile. On a refetch, the `inset: 0` shimmer and the top-right loader then attach to the nearest positioned ancestor instead, such as the Kpis strip, the Section or the page. The `data-compact` attribute that used to mark the refreshing state is also no longer emitted, so any compact-specific loader styling is lost.

I could not see the Kpi tile markup to confirm where StateFrame sits. Fix: use a descendant match for tiles too (`.openui-dashboard-kpi-compact:has(.openui-dashboard-sheen)`), or check that the sheen is always a direct child of the tile.
